reviews.comment: I took her for 203 and gave a subpar review here before, but I took her for 434 and take it back! When teaching a more specific subject (203 had way too many broad topics) she was absolutely wonderful and I learned a lot. She cares so much about the students and wants us to succeed and be engaged. I really enjoyed taking this course with her.

I don't understand why there are so many bad reviews. I took Dr. Ghatak this past semester, and she is really caring and knowledgeable towards what she teaches. The exams are easy, and if you study the smallest amount or not at all you will still pass.
This professor was great. I took her class in the Fall of 2021, and I liked how she approached the science behind natural disasters. If you work hard, she will see that as well.

A really nice person, but the lectures aren't always the best. I just followed along with her powerpoints (which were really helpful), and I did just fine. Every quiz and exam was open note so there's no need to stress. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it makes her sad when people don't try to participate :( Overall, not a bad choice at all.

She is a nice lady but definitely read the textbook. She goes quite fast during lectures and is hard to understand at times. She is very willing to help but most of her questions on the tests and quizzes can be found in the textbook so read that instead of focusing too much on the lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There was a lot of reading to do and the lectures were often confusing. If you take this class be prepared to study a lot especially for the midterm and final since those are the main grades for this course, each worth 35% of your grade. There are also weekly quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Ghatak is an extremely nice lady and tries hard to teach her class, but she was overall not a great professor. Her lectures were not engaging and she will rarely answer any of your questions clearly. You will need to read the textbook to learn. I do not recommend her for this class!

Professor Ghatak seems like a nice lady, but is not a good teacher really. Reads straight from slides which are word for word from textbook. Expects you to fully comprehend the lesson after her reading it once. Again, a nice lady but made what is supposed to be an easy course harder than it had to be

She's a nice person, but one of the worst professors I've had yet. Her quizzes and tests have obscure information not even mentioned in her lectures! She goes EXTREMELY fast, and constantly has technical issues. I'm usually a fast learner and do good in tough classes, but in here I'm genuinely learning nothing. Im constantly stressed about my grade

Accent is hard to understand, and she talks very fast--faster than most people can type or write what she says. Her quizzes and tests have very obscure questions, do not match up with the lectures, and aren't about basic topics or ideas. Reading the textbook is the only way to really understand what is going on most of the time.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you can help it. Get another professor. I learned absolutely nothing in the lectures and had to teach myself all of the info. Instructions for every assignment were unclear and I was constantly scrambling to figure out what was going on. TAKE WITH A DIFFERENT PROFESSOR!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really bad lecturer. Like the worst I've had in college thus far. Buy the textbook and just read that instead of going to class. Or if possible, just take a different prof
